about_the_game:
BATTLE TITANS - WITH FRIENDS OR ALONE

Titan Isles is set on the planet of Toska, a vibrant world abound with diverse biomes. Mysterious Titans awaken from deep within the planet, shattering Toska to ruins as they emerge to wreak havoc and destroy everything in their path.

This adventure casts you - the player, into an epic struggle for survival and revenge either alone or in up to 4-player co-op, across a thrilling and challenging multi-part campaign.

USE POWERFUL EXO SUITS

Before launching into each mission, you’ll choose from one of four Exo Suits; Storm, Hunter, Goliath or Blink. With Jet Packs, Grappling Hooks, Burst Jets or Phase-Dash abilities respectively, each Exo Suit enables you to explore a variety of strategies.

Each Exo Suit also comes equipped with a signature weapon designed to synergise with its traversal method; Plasma Pistols with a Longstrike Rifle, a bow with Kyros arrows, a powerful Kyros canon and protective shield and a deadly Viper Bolt projectile.

PLAY ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS

The full game from start-to-finish can be enjoyed as a single player campaign or you can invite your friends in up-to 4-player co-op. Strategise to take on the challenges ahead, each equipping a different Exo Suit for complete weapon coverage, or alternatively all wear your favourite Suits, even if another player equips the same Suit!

UNCOVER THE SECRETS OF THE TITANS

With a wide variety of Titans at large throughout the campaign, it's up to you and your team to locate and defeat them all. Along the way you'll uncover the motivations and secrets behind the existence of the Titans and their destructive attack on the world of Toska.

TRAVERSE A PLETHORA OF ENVIRONMENTS

As you progress, you'll discover the many different biomes that together, form the vibrant world of Titan Isles. Each chapter of the campaign will introduce a new environment to explore!
